to.name: IETF CUBIC specification lineage RFC 8312 → RFC 9438

property: IETF documentation standardizes an already implemented and broadly deployed CUBIC lineage rather than serving as the source from which the original Linux implementation was written.
negative_claims: Linux did not originally implement CUBIC from RFC 8312 or RFC 9438.
Internal Linux CUBIC version numbers do not map one-to-one to RFC document revisions.
open_questions: Map RFC text changes to corresponding implementation commits across Linux, Windows and Apple stacks.
notes: Separates implementation clock from standards clock.
